title: Finally got combat working properly!
author: CosmikStudios
selftext:
Been working on this thing for a while now and figured I'd start sharing progress. I actually asked for help here before on how to generate a background image for my combat scenes and got a lot of great hints!

I'm calling this Darkest Exiles. We recruit heroes, gear them up, send them into dungeons and then watch some of them die. The ones who survive might get trauma. Fun!

Built with SwiftUI + SpriteKit. I'm using [Ludo.ai](http://Ludo.ai) for the sprite generation and opus been my senior dev.

What you're seeing is the combat system — it's tick-based with a 2x4 formation grid. Each hero has abilities on cooldowns and their own AI behavior trees (the healer finally stopped ignoring dying teammates as of yesterday lol).

I'm getting pretty close to a potential alpha so I can invite people to try it out through Testflight. If you have thoughts on the combat or the overall aesthetic I'd love to hear them. If you have any questions about it, please shoot!

comments.author: MakkoMakkerton
comments.body: This is rad! Would definitely be interested in a demo. Any advice on when working through the game? What did you find more important initial prompts or an overall structure?

replies.author: CosmikStudios
replies.body:
That's great to hear! I've setup a discord to get the Testflight invites for beta testing going as soon as it's possible.

If I had to pick a few, I'd say having a very descriptive game design document before even starting, make sure to add rules, guidelines and structure to enforce and keep things tidy and more importantly, and also unfortunately, police the ai agents every step of the way because they'll do so many things wrong :D
